name: Vesicular-Veil
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs solar wind erosion patterns, stark under a black sky.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Whoever abandoned the derelict space station in orbit did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
